extra_fields.difficulty: easy = the narrative or data uses the obvious word or value; medium = ordinary wording a keyword list may or may not hold; hard = described as what was done, without the usual keyword, or a boundary value

extra_fields.must_not_flag: every line with no planted violation, by invoice. A finding of any rule on these lines is a false positive, except invoice-level findings listed in planted with line_no null
extra_fields.invoice_files: file name and layout of each invoice
